items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: This guy was playing lead jazz (inaudible) and Navarro's supposed to play solos.

ctx.x: The third thing happen to this guy, it was (inaudible) me too at the same time he got killed. The guys used to play (inaudible) trumpet with the (inaudible) with Tom Mirosso (phonetic), big, fat guy. What was the name? (Inaudible).

He was -- we were rehearsing a suite somebody from California wrote for me, and those two guys are there. This guy was playing lead jazz (inaudible) and Navarro's supposed to play solos. Navarro was -- as you say, was a mechanical Dizzy Gillespie.
